glass: rocks glass, one large clear cube
_status: v1.1 (Tomás, round 4). Tommy's structure (Bermejo: tequila, lime, agave thinned 1:1, Joy pdf 397-398), our measures. agave_nectar = blue agave syrup; the 10 ml water is the thinning.
